english.description: As Poirot says, everybody has brains, but they differ in quality! Yours are exceptional. You've solved one question.

english.description: You believe that symmetry is the source of all beauty and that order creates virtue.
english.name: trophy_name_21

english.description: You believe that symmetry is the source of all beauty and that order generates virtue. What a pleasure it is to sort through things and tidy up!
english.name: trophy_name_22

english.description: You believe that symmetry is the source of all beauty and that order generates virtue. What a pleasure it is to sort through things and tidy up! You are loyal to Poirot's spirit.
english.name: trophy_name_23

english.description: Even Poirot sometimes makes mistakes …
english.name: trophy_name_24

english.description: Even Poirot sometimes makes mistakes … but he doesn't make as many as you!
english.name: trophy_name_25

english.description: Even Poirot sometimes makes mistakes … but he doesn't make as many as you! Get a grip on yourself before your reputation is tarnished.
english.name: trophy_name_26

english.description: Comfort is important! This trophy is being awarded to you simply for having taken the time to sit down in a good chair!
english.name: trophy_name_27

english.description: Your moustache is at the heart of your personal care. That is why it is so exceptional!
english.name: trophy_name_28

english.description: "Glory to the hand of man, the equal of his mind!" One is nothing without the other and it is by using both that you were able to solve a riddle!
english.name: trophy_name_29

english.description: "Glory to the hand of man, the equal of his mind!" One is nothing without the other and it is by using both that you were able to solve half of the riddles!
english.name: trophy_name_30

english.description: "Glory to the hand of man, the equal of his mind!" One is nothing without the other and it is by using both that you were able to solve all of the riddles!
english.name: trophy_name_31

english.description: The newspapers are talking about the case, therefore, they are also talking about you. Do not hesitate to read them: fame is not all that unpleasant.
english.name: trophy_name_32

english.description: You are being stoned by the press, but you are taking matters very calmly. All great men have had their moments of solitude.
english.name: trophy_name_33

english.description: The newspapers that were criticising you yesterday are praising you today. Be honest, it is much nicer.
english.name: trophy_name_34

english.description: "Thus spake Poirot". You've done your thinking all on your own, then, like Zarathustra, you revealed the truth to all. You've coordinated the final meeting without a single hitch. Congratulations!
english.name: trophy_name_35

english.description: Well done! You've interpreted Donald Fraser's dream with as much assurance as the great Sigmund himself.
english.name: trophy_name_36

english.description: For Hastings, you've skilfully shown the theory of the relativity of viewpoints: that of a sick old lady has as much value as that of a pretty and young girl.
english.name: trophy_name_37

english.description: You have proved your artistic flair by discussing porcelain with Thora Grey.
english.name: trophy_name_38

english.description: Masterful! You've opened Sir Carmichael's secret drawer! You've put the animals in the right place. Take your rightful place: that of the Emperor in the middle!
english.name: trophy_name_39

english.description: As you were loading the revolver you entrusted to Hastings with blanks, you clearly chose a non-violent approach to the problem. You'll thank yourself for it!
english.name: trophy_name_40

english.description: Masterful! You intervened just in time! Your fortuitous telephone call probably saved the life of the owner of the Black Swan Hotel.
english.name: trophy_name_41

english.description: This anti-trophy is awarded to you for having made poor little Mary Drower cry. You showed a brutality unworthy of Hercule Poirot. Get a grip on yourself!
english.name: trophy_name_42

english.description: Your lack of attention to detail very nearly cost poor Donbar his life! You were perfectly aware that you had to handle him carefully owing to his weak heart! Let's hope that it is a lesson to you.
english.name: trophy_name_43

english.description: You've tamed the Nordic firestorm: Thora Grey was unable to protect her secrets and you have brought them to light with the force of your logic.
english.name: trophy_name_44

english.description: Intention purifies the action! Some indiscretions are tolerated in the interest of truth, such as: searching without a warrant, reading the Clarke's correspondence, and opening a parcel addressed to Thora Grey.
english.name: trophy_name_45

english.description: Did you feel the pervasive presence of the great black dragon at Combeside? It is on Sir Carmichael's watch, the books in his library, Thora Grey's brooch, and the teapot in the lounge.
english.name: trophy_name_46

english.description: Is your mind playing tricks on you? You are taking the curse of the dragon seriously and you are accusing Thora Grey of black magic! Do not let your imagination run wild, it's unworthy of Hercule Poirot.
english.name: trophy_name_47

english.description: You cannot hide anything from Uncle Poirot. He pierces the best kept secrets of the heart with great ease. For example, those of the beautiful Thora!
english.name: trophy_name_48

english.description: You are helpful, it's a great quality. You are winning this trophy for having taken care of Lady Clarke and Cust.
english.name: trophy_name_49

english.description: Well done! On your own initiative and thanks to your talents in graphology, you have proved the common origin of the letters sent by the killer.
english.name: trophy_name_50
